name: LA Peptides Universal Label System
description: Single, machine-readable entry point for this package. Read this file first: it lists every canonical source, derived deliverable, placeholder asset, schema, and doc in the package, plus the full set of editable region/field ids, so a web app, the sales app, the admin portal, production software, or a future API can discover what's here and how to use it without inspecting the filesystem.

canonicalSources.note: themes are the legacy flat theme-file interface (still supported). New integrations should prefer brand-profiles/ + product-profiles/ below.

profiles.note: The recommended authoring interface: one brand-profile.json per partner + one product-profile.json per product/batch. See RENDERING-SPEC.md for the exact composition algorithm.

derivedDeliverables.note: All four are reproducible from canonicalSources via `npm run build:master` / `npm run build:components` — see buildTooling below. Do not hand-edit them; edit master-label.svg/label-spec.json/layout.json and rebuild instead.

componentSystem.note: Every visible object in master-label.svg (27 total) is an independently addressable component — id, type, layer, percentage position, lock state, default placeholder, alignment, auto-fit bounds, field key (if content-editable), and every theme token restyling it. components.json is a derived join of label-spec.json + layout.json; regenerate with `npm run build:components`.

examples.note: Three fully worked brand.json + product.json pairs (distinct palettes/fonts/logo marks) with committed preview.png renders, proving master-label.svg reskins cleanly without modification. See examples/README.md.

buildTooling.legacyUsage: node scripts/build.js --theme <theme.json> [--fields <field-map.json>] --out <dir> [--zip]. Omitting --fields keeps master-label.svg's neutral placeholders (this is how the derivedDeliverables above are produced).

idConvention: Every id above is used identically as: the SVG element id in master-label.svg, the fieldKey/elementId pair in label-spec.json's "fields" registry, and the region id in layout.json's "regions" array. One flat, snake_case identifier per editable thing, consistent across all three files — that is the whole integration contract.
notes: No real or fictional brand identity is represented anywhere in this package — every value is a neutral placeholder.
This is a reusable design engine, not a label for any specific company: no app, website, database, login system, or ordering portal is included.
Independent of the sales app, website, pricing tools, and market-analysis work elsewhere in this repository.

product-profile.schema.json accepts an optional productCategory field for downstream systems (admin/inventory) — it is not yet bound to a visual element on this physical label format; see VALIDATION-RULES.md.
